Frost Bite#001.src: Are you here to cross the Great Bridge as well?

Frost Bite#002.src: I fear you'll have to wait, the warning wasn't without merit.

Frost Bite#003.src: The {p} military has issued an official warning to all travelers wishing to cross the Great Bridge.

Frost Bite#004.src: No one should use the bridge until they have dealt with the... underlying issue.

Frost Bite#005.src: I ignored the warning at first, since the bridge is the only path into the jungle...

Frost Bite#006.src: But attempting to cross the bridge proved unbearable. Even out here, can't you feel that intense heat?

Frost Bite#007.src: I wouldn't blame anyone for not wanting to venture further, let alone meet whatever is causing this heat!

Frost Bite#008.src: And so I've been waiting here with my assistant all day... We're potion makers, you see, and we were headed to the grand city of {p} to sell supplies.

Frost Bite#009.src: If you want to ignore the military's warning, I suppose you might benefit from buying some our stock first. Our potions are stronger than any sold in {p}, after all!

Frost Bite#010.src: From the look of your equipment... I'd say you might have a better chance of making it across than us.

Frost Bite#011.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up and take a look at the drill, would you?

Frost Bite#012.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, I have a carriage for it.

Frost Bite#013.src: Sir Theorick, if you, um...if you have a moment? Your tribute is here...

Frost Bite#014.src: ...good. Thank you. Good to see some who honestly respect what I'm trying to do for all of you. Was there anyone else?

Frost Bite#015.src: Ah...no. There...there wasn't. Not this time. They feel like you're taking too much from them, which I don't agree with, but-

Frost Bite#016.src: ...ask them, if they would prefer their money, or their lives. Am I not protecting them? Is it really so much to ask that I get something in return?

Frost Bite#017.src: We...we know. We told them that, too...we're sorry.

Frost Bite#018.src: You aren't the ones who need to apologize! I'm aware it's a voluntary contribution, but do they have any idea how difficult it is to cast magic like this regularly?!

Frost Bite#019.src: This is unbeliveable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.

Frost Bite#020.src: There must be some way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.

Frost Bite#021.src: Wow, even by todays standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.
Frost Bite#021.dst: 와, 지금 기준으로 봐도 어마어마한 돈이에요. 수백 년 전엔 얼마나 큰돈이었을지 생각해 봐요.

Frost Bite#022.src: Find Eppo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The entrance to his cave can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Frost Bite#025.src: Darn. The drill just won't start.
Frost Bite#025.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#026.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up here to the drill, maybe you can take a look?
Frost Bite#026.dst: 이봐요, 경비병! Electromagic에 대해 좀 알아요? 드릴 있는 데로 올라와서 한번 봐 줄래요?
Frost Bite#026.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#027.src: Oh! Never mind, it lit up, back up!
Frost Bite#027.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#028.src: For the love of Bob... Why won't you just break?
Frost Bite#028.dst: Bob을 봐서라도... 왜 안 깨지는 거야?
Frost Bite#028.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#029.src: This ice was created by Theorick, a Twain who defended this area many many years ago.
Frost Bite#029.dst: 이 얼음은 아주 오래전 이 지역을 지키던 Twain, Theorick이 만든 거예요.
Frost Bite#029.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#030.src: When the corruption got too much... He froze everything, including the people. Do you see them in there?
Frost Bite#030.dst: 타락이 걷잡을 수 없게 되자... 그는 모든 걸 얼려 버렸어요. 사람까지요. 저 안에 사람들 보이죠?
Frost Bite#030.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#031.src: We've tried desperately to get them out, but we've tried all the equipment we had, including this Corkian drill.
Frost Bite#031.dst: 어떻게든 꺼내려고 이 Corkus 드릴까지 가진 장비는 전부 써 봤어요.
Frost Bite#031.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#032.src: Maybe we should get more destructive... The demolition expert, Rhudya, is further down the cave.
Frost Bite#032.dst: 좀 더 과격하게 가야 할지도... 폭파 전문가 Rhudya가 동굴 더 안쪽에 있어요.
Frost Bite#032.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#033.src: It's a long shot, but worth a try. Would you be able to get it while I clear this space?
Frost Bite#033.dst: 가능성은 낮지만 해 볼 만해요. 제가 여길 치우는 동안 가져다줄 수 있어요?
Frost Bite#033.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#034.src: Go deeper into the cave and speak to Rhudya.
Frost Bite#034.dst: 동굴 더 깊이 들어가 Rhudya와 대화하세요.

Frost Bite#035.src: Whup! You're on private property, y'know! Oh, Eppo sent ya? That's fair enough.
Frost Bite#035.dst: 워! 여긴 사유지라고! 아, Eppo가 보냈어? 그럼 됐지.
Frost Bite#035.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#036.src: You'll be needing this TNT then, make sure not to drop it though, whup!
Frost Bite#036.dst: 그럼 이 TNT가 필요하겠네. 떨어뜨리진 마, 워!
Frost Bite#036.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#037.src: Just travel through this cave and you'll be returned to Eppo easy-peasy!
Frost Bite#037.dst: 이 동굴만 지나면 Eppo한테 금방 돌아갈 수 있어!
Frost Bite#037.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#038.src: Return to Eppo with the tnt.

Frost Bite#039.src: Very nice, this might do the trick.
Frost Bite#039.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#040.src: Back up, I'll ignite the explosive.
Frost Bite#040.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#042.src: NOTHING? Not even a scratch. I don't understand Theoricks ice.. It's not real.
Frost Bite#042.dst: 아무것도? 흠집 하나 없잖아. Theorick의 얼음은 이해가 안 가요.. 진짜가 아니에요.
Frost Bite#042.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#043.src: I'm not sure what else we can do then...
Frost Bite#043.dst: 그럼 더 뭘 할 수 있을지 모르겠네요...
Frost Bite#043.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#044.src: HEY. Eppo, over here! Near the cave!
Frost Bite#044.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#045.src: Did the explosive not work? I found this old mineshaft on the way back from the cave, it leads to an old lava cavern.
Frost Bite#045.dst: 폭탄 안 먹혔어? 동굴에서 돌아오다가 옛 갱도를 찾았는데, 오래된 용암 동굴로 이어져.
Frost Bite#045.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#046.src: Might be a long shot, but this lava looks different. Why not give it a try?
Frost Bite#046.dst: 가능성은 낮을지 몰라도, 거기 용암은 좀 달라 보여. 한번 해 보는 게 어때?
Frost Bite#046.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#047.src: Travel to the lava springs through the mineshaft.

Frost Bite#048.src: Complete the puzzle and bring the lava back to Eppo.

Frost Bite#049.src: I don't understand how you can hold lava in a bucket.. But here we are.
Frost Bite#049.dst: 용암을 양동이에 어떻게 담는지 모르겠지만.. 어쨌든 이렇게 됐네요.
Frost Bite#049.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#050.src: Truth is.. We're not retrieving these bodies for no reason.
Frost Bite#050.dst: 사실은.. 이유 없이 시신을 꺼내려는 게 아니에요.
Frost Bite#050.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#051.src: We believe one of these people worked for Theorick, and has a key to his mansion
Frost Bite#051.dst: 이 사람들 중 하나가 Theorick 밑에서 일했고, 그의 저택 열쇠를 갖고 있다고 봐요
Frost Bite#051.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#052.src: We in {p} think Theorick has a lot to answer for. We want to redistribute his wealth among those he hurt.
Frost Bite#052.dst: {p} 사람들은 Theorick이 책임질 게 많다고 생각해요. 그가 해친 사람들에게 그의 재산을 나눠 주고 싶어요.
Frost Bite#052.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#053.src: Right, I've dipped this stick in the magical lava. Just hold the rod and walk into the ice to melt it.
Frost Bite#053.dst: 자, 이 막대를 마법 용암에 담갔어요. 막대를 들고 얼음 속으로 걸어가면 녹을 거예요.
Frost Bite#053.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#054.src: Look for the corpse with a key, it might be above you. Good luck!
Frost Bite#054.dst: 열쇠를 가진 시신을 찾아요. 위쪽에 있을지도 몰라요. 행운을 빌어요!
Frost Bite#054.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#055.src: Melt the ice and find the Servant's corpse.

Frost Bite#056.src: Is that the right one? You got it? Brilliant! Now come back down.
Frost Bite#056.dst: 그게 맞아요? 찾았어요? 훌륭해요! 이제 내려와요.
Frost Bite#056.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#057.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, lets take my horse.
Frost Bite#057.dst: 같이 저택으로 가요. 자, 제 말을 타고 가죠.
Frost Bite#057.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#058.src: While we ride, let me explain a little more about what we're doing. Let's go.
Frost Bite#058.dst: 가는 동안 우리가 뭘 하는지 좀 더 설명할게요. 가죠.
Frost Bite#058.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#059.src: As I mentioned before, there is a reason this land is frozen, and it's not natural.
Frost Bite#059.dst: 아까 말했듯이 이 땅이 얼어붙은 데는 이유가 있고, 자연적인 게 아니에요.
Frost Bite#059.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#060.src: Many years before Bob was around, Wynn was in ruins due to the corruption war.
Frost Bite#060.dst: Bob이 있기 훨씬 전, Wynn은 타락 전쟁으로 폐허가 됐어요.
Frost Bite#060.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#061.src: In those times there used to be a group of naturally gifted individuals called the Twains. They defended us all with elemental magic.
Frost Bite#061.dst: 그 시절엔 Twain이라 불리는 타고난 재능을 가진 사람들이 있었어요. 원소 마법으로 우리 모두를 지켰죠.
Frost Bite#061.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#062.src: Theorick was one of those Twains. He harnessed unnaturally powerful ice based magic. He used it to protect the land surrounding the mansion.
Frost Bite#062.dst: Theorick도 그 Twain 중 하나였어요. 비정상적으로 강한 얼음 마법을 다뤘고, 그 힘으로 저택 주변 땅을 지켰죠.
Frost Bite#062.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#063.src: Theorick.. Wasn't like the other Twains. He wanted the people he protected to pay and feed him as way of thanks.
Frost Bite#063.dst: Theorick은.. 다른 Twain들과 달랐어요. 자기가 지켜 준 사람들에게 감사의 뜻으로 돈과 음식을 바치게 했죠.
Frost Bite#063.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#064.src: After years, Theorick was rich while the people he protected lived in poverty and fear - not only of the monsters, but in fear of Theorick himself.
Frost Bite#064.dst: 몇 년 뒤 Theorick은 부자가 됐지만, 그가 지킨 사람들은 가난과 공포 속에 살았어요 - 괴물뿐 아니라 Theorick 자신도 두려워하면서요.
Frost Bite#064.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#065.src: He punished those who disobeyed his curfews and would get angry if anyone tried to move away. The people felt trapped.
Frost Bite#065.dst: 통금을 어긴 사람은 벌을 받았고, 누가 떠나려 하면 화를 냈어요. 사람들은 갇힌 기분이었죠.
Frost Bite#065.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#066.src: Eventually, just like the other Twains - Theorick fell to the corruption. Not before he had the last word.
Frost Bite#066.dst: 결국 다른 Twain들처럼 - Theorick도 타락에 굴복했어요. 하지만 마지막 한 수는 남겼죠.
Frost Bite#066.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#067.src: He froze the land entirely, killing almost everything and everyone left outside in it. Hundreds of lives were lost.
Frost Bite#067.dst: 그는 이 땅을 통째로 얼려서, 밖에 남아 있던 거의 모든 것을 죽였어요. 수백 명이 목숨을 잃었죠.
Frost Bite#067.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#068.src: It turns out the ice slowed the spread of corruption across the land to almost a standstill. It's been this way ever since.
Frost Bite#068.dst: 그런데 그 얼음 덕에 이 땅에서 타락이 퍼지는 게 거의 멈췄어요. 그 뒤로 쭉 이 상태예요.
Frost Bite#068.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#069.src: Now that we can get in his mansion we hope to uncover the secrets of his ice magic so we may undo it, and share the wealth he hoarded from the people. Ah, we're here.
Frost Bite#069.dst: 이제 저택에 들어갈 수 있으니, 그의 얼음 마법의 비밀을 밝혀 되돌리고, 사람들에게서 긁어모은 재산도 나누고 싶어요. 아, 다 왔네요.
Frost Bite#069.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#071.src: This place looks frozen in time.. The grandure.. Well he did just take and take from everyone around him.
Frost Bite#071.dst: 시간이 얼어붙은 것 같네요.. 이 호화로움.. 뭐, 주변 모두에게서 빼앗고 또 빼앗았으니까요.
Frost Bite#071.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#072.src: So, I'm not sure where to start, but I'm guessing he has some protection in place.
Frost Bite#072.dst: 어디서부터 시작할지 모르겠지만, 뭔가 방어 장치를 해 뒀을 것 같아요.
Frost Bite#072.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#073.src: This is unbelievable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.
Frost Bite#073.dst: 믿을 수가 없네요.. 정말 탐욕스러운- 으아아악.
Frost Bite#073.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#074.src: ... I don't think we should insult him..
Frost Bite#074.dst: ... 그를 모욕하면 안 될 것 같네요..
Frost Bite#074.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#075.src: Find the riches in Theorick's mansion.

Frost Bite#076.src: Oof! Wasn't expecting that. That just proves everything I said about him. Punishing people who insult him.
Frost Bite#076.dst: 윽! 이건 예상 못 했어요. 제 말이 다 맞았다는 증거죠. 자길 모욕하면 벌을 내리는 거예요.
Frost Bite#076.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#077.src: Anyway, we should look around for some kind of secret entrance.
Frost Bite#077.dst: 아무튼, 비밀 입구 같은 게 있는지 둘러봐야겠어요.
Frost Bite#077.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#078.src: Trust Theorick to booby trap his own house the paranoid frozen gro-
Frost Bite#078.dst: 역시 Theorick답게 자기 집에 함정을 깔았네, 이 의심 많은 얼어붙은 늙은-
Frost Bite#078.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#079.src: That really isn't fun at all. I can't see a thing. Where are we now, a dead end?
Frost Bite#079.dst: 이건 전혀 재미없네요. 아무것도 안 보여요. 여긴 어디죠, 막다른 길?
Frost Bite#079.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#080.src: Well we know that insults result in punishment. Maybe a compliment will make him happy?
Frost Bite#080.dst: 모욕하면 벌을 받는다는 건 알았으니, 칭찬하면 기뻐하지 않을까요?
Frost Bite#080.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#081.src: Oh Theorick, strongest of all the Twains, you really are a hero.
Frost Bite#081.dst: 오 Theorick, Twain 중 가장 강한 분, 당신은 정말 영웅이에요.
Frost Bite#081.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#083.src: Looks like we finally found his private quarters, look at that vault door.
Frost Bite#083.dst: 드디어 그의 개인 거처를 찾은 것 같아요. 저 금고 문 좀 봐요.
Frost Bite#083.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#084.src: There must be a way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.
Frost Bite#084.dst: 열 방법이 있을 거예요. 주위를 둘러보고 뭘 찾을 수 있나 봐요.
Frost Bite#084.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#085.src: Find your way into the vault.

Frost Bite#086.src: You did it! We have access to the vault.
Frost Bite#086.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#088.src: Grab a little for yourself, too, we wouldn't have been able to get here without you.
Frost Bite#088.dst: 당신도 좀 챙겨요. 당신 없이는 여기까지 못 왔을 거예요.
Frost Bite#088.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#089.src: Wait, look at this. It seems to be a piece of Theoricks armour.
Frost Bite#089.dst: 잠깐, 이것 좀 봐요. Theorick의 갑옷 한 조각 같아요.
Frost Bite#089.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#090.src: Surprised it even managed to fit over his fat head.
Frost Bite#090.dst: 이게 그 큰 머리에 들어갔다니 놀랍네요.
Frost Bite#090.speaker: Eppo
